messages.subject: For Nicolas Hieronimus | Global affairs, sustainability and emerging-market execution
messages.body:
Dear LOREAL Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Nicolas Hieronimus, Chief Executive Officer.

LOREAL's global portfolio operates across governments, communities, sustainability expectations and rapidly evolving consumer markets. That stakeholder environment closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and emerging-market stakeholder execution might support LOREAL's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to LOREAL.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
